name: Veo 3.1
description: Cinematic video generation model for high-end creative storytelling and experimental video production, supporting professional-grade 4K output, natively synchronized audio, and complex camera movements. Shuts down on October 22, 2026; the recommended replacement is Gemini Omni Flash.

sources.title: Veo 3.1 model page
sources.notes: Preview model code veo-3.1-generate-preview, supported data types, and the 1,024 token text input limit. The page also lists veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview under the same entry.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: Billed per second of output video, not per token, so no token pricing is recorded.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.notes: Recommended replacement is gemini-omni-1.1-flash; shutdown date October 22, 2026.
